scope: Native single-frame Secondary Capture, unsigned8 RGB planar 0/1, YBR_FULL planar 0/1 and even-width YBR_FULL_422 planar 0. Seven prepared positive fixtures accepted; nineteen other fixtures rejected with expected structured categories. No public revision/type/dependency change. Full IOD conformance and color management are not claimed.

manifest.source: generated locally from literal samples; no patient or external source data
manifest.use: project contract tests; generated binaries are cache-only
manifest.oracle: independent literal stored samples, slope/intercept arithmetic and RGBA bytes

manifest.scope: fixture preparation only; minimal pixel-module files, not full IOD conformance or product support
manifest.standard: DICOM PS3.3 2026d C.7.6.3 and C.8.5.6, consulted 2026-10-01
manifest.oracle: literal stored/RGB/RGBA arrays; independent reader checks; no product decoder output
manifest.pixel_data_vr: explicit OB for 8-bit pixels, OW for 16-bit pixels; implicit VR inferred by reader; palette tables OW with source syntax endian
manifest.us_policy: C.8.5.6.1.2 requires RGB for native multi-sample US. C.8-23 YBR_FULL planar0/1 row does not grant native Photometric acceptance; US YBR is unsupported target with generic raw color readback only. C.8-20 specializes dense16 palette to 16-bit unsigned indices.
manifest.ybr_policy: full-range BT.601 inverse, nearest integer then clamp; target tolerance <=1
